pages.text: Little round things clustered among the water plants by the spring stream. Soft and squishy, like jelly.
"What are these? I want to see what they become." Mumu crouched down. He left a pebble by the water to find the same spot each day.
Dodo glanced over. "Water grapes. They'll bloom in a few days. I know!"
The next day, they returned to the pebble. Dark dots had appeared inside the round things.
Dodo spread both wings. "See? Flower seeds! Soon they'll bloom!"
Another day passed. The dark dots wriggled.
Dodo rubbed her eyes. "The flowers... are squirming?"
A few days later, tiny dark babies slipped out of the round things and swam. Their tails swished.
Mom passed with a laundry basket and smiled. "Tadpoles. They're baby frogs."
Dodo lifted her chin. "That's what I meant... swimming flowers!" The tadpoles wriggled as if answering.
